effect_description_eng:
When you would play this card, by placing 1 [Shoutmon] as a digivolution card under this Digimon, reduce the cost by 1 and you may place cards in your trash as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.
[On Play] Return all of the digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck, and return that Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
[Your Turn] All of your opponent's [Security] effects on Option cards don't activate.
xros_req:
DigiXros Requirements [DigiXros -1] ∞ Digimon cards w/[Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait & different card numbers
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
